title: The Night of Victory
english: Of the blessed Hesychius, presbyter of Jerusalem, on the Holy Pascha.

The sky is bright, lit up by the dance of the stars, and the whole universe is brighter still when the morning star rises. Yet this present night is lit up not so much by the stars as it now exults because our God and Savior has conquered. For 'Take courage,' he says, 'I have overcome the world' (John 16:33). And since God has conquered the invisible enemy, we too shall rightly win the victory over the demons. Let us, then, stay beside the saving cross, so that we may win the first fruits of the gifts of Jesus. Let us keep this holy night as a festival with holy torchlight, raising a song inspired by God and singing out a heavenly hymn. 'The sun of righteousness' (Malachi 4:2), our Lord Jesus Christ, has lit up this present day for the whole circle of the world; he rose through the cross; he saved the faithful.

Let no one, then, distrust the emblems of the cross; rather, let him worship the blessed and thrice-blessed wood of the cross, and the emblems of the cross that opened the doors of heaven to us. No longer do 'they light a lamp and put it under the basket' (Matthew 5:15), and by the basket I mean the Law, 'but on the lampstand', and by the lamp I mean the Word.
